name: com.skeletiq/mcp
title: SkeletIQ
description: Hand a released SkeletIQ architecture to a coding agent: brief, build order, drift check.

environmentVariables.name: SKELETIQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A SkeletIQ personal API token (starts skq_), created under Settings -> Agent access. Needs the read scope at minimum; add generate to create designs and report to check drift.

environmentVariables.name: SKELETIQ_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SkeletIQ API. Only needed for self-hosted installs; defaults to the hosted service.
